title: Objectwise integral compactness with the uniform Ext bound explicit
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a finite intermediate extension of Q_ℓ. Let k have characteristic p>0 different from ℓ, and X be separated and finite type over k. Let Λ be the condensed valuation ring O_E. Suppose d assigns a natural number to each constant-model constructible sheaf C, and Hom(C[0],N[0][q]) is subsingleton for every constructible N and q>d(C). Then each bounded constructible finite-Tor object in Loc(Dctf(X,Λ)) is compact, with respect to any specified coproduct structure. The Ext bound is an essential explicit assumption, not a claimed consequence of the field hypothesis.

theorem brownHypotheses_integral_object_compactness_of_ext_bounded
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ (C N : ConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)
      (q : ℤ), (d C : ℤ) < q →
        Subsingleton (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj C.obj) ⟶
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N.obj)⟦q⟧))
    (hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1}
      (localizingClosureProEtale (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X).FullSubcategory)
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) :
    @IsCompactObject _ _ _ hSums K
